baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعل مع الله إلها آخر ... فألقياه في العذاب الشديد
baseline_models.mechanism: The status-making branch of جعل assigns an other the rank of worshipped deity; the throwing branch then reverses that agency by assigning the assigner to an intense punitive destination.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to occupy a state supplies the offender's assignment of divine rank.
Worship and the worshipped object supply the rank being assigned.
Otherness after or apart from the first marks the rival addition.
Deliberate throwing supplies the counter-placement imposed on the offender.
Painful punishment identifies the destination as penal rather than merely spatial.
Force and hardness supply the destination's intensity.

changed_reading.before: A polytheist is ordered into severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: The offender first installs an other in divine rank and is then, in a reversal of placement power, forcibly installed in punishment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The saying-or-naming branch of جعل permits a classificatory act: an other is designated and authorized as a worshipped deity alongside God, without implying literal production of a god.

activation_trace.role: Saying or naming supplies the act of designation.
The worshipped-object sense supplies the conferred category.
The other-than-first sense identifies the category's rival bearer.

changed_reading.after: He named or authorized an other as a worshipped deity alongside God; the offense is classificatory and cultic, not ontological production.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same casting root appears in a في frame at 50:7 for setting firm mountains in the earth. That material pattern sharpens 50:26 from momentary hurling to settled punitive emplacement.

activation_trace.role: Casting something into a location supplies the earlier spatial placement frame.
Firm settling supplies the result-state of the earlier cast objects.
The punitive command reuses the cast-into placement action.
Hard force reinforces the settled destination as severe.

structural_cues: 50:7 and 50:26 repeat an ألقي plus في frame around an object and its destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casting into the earth plus firmly settled mountains; I transfer only that result-state to the punitive casting. The live alternative is momentary violent throwing with no emplacement resonance.

changed_reading.after: Set him down within punishment as a forcefully settled destination, extending the baseline counter-placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired receivers, then a driver and witness, then the repeated dual casting command form a procedural relay from intake through escorted evidence to punitive deposition. The focus command becomes the closing handoff of a process.

activation_trace.role: Reception or encounter supplies the intake action performed by the paired receivers.
Driving and expulsion supply controlled movement of the arriving soul.
Presence with observation supplies the evidentiary function accompanying custody.
The first dual cast-into command opens the execution frame.
The repeated dual command closes the frame after the offender's description.

structural_cues: Dual morphology recurs at 50:17, 50:24, and 50:26, while 50:21 supplies two differentiated escort functions.
The dual cast-into command at 50:24 is resumed at 50:26 around the intervening offender descriptors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence of paired reception, driver-witness accompaniment, and dual casting; I infer procedural continuity, not identity of personnel. The pairs may differ, and the second command may be simple emphasis.

changed_reading.before: An unexplained pair performs a violent command.
changed_reading.after: The dual command reads as the resumptive final handoff in an escorted and witnessed judgment process, while the agents' identities remain open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The naming branch of جعل becomes more active when every utterance is emitted under guard and the soul arrives with a witness. Making another deity can therefore include an accountable declaration or naming act preserved as evidence.

activation_trace.role: Naming supplies the focus act that context can render evidentiary.
The object-of-worship sense supplies what the declaration authorizes.
Emitting speech by the tongue supplies the recordable form of designation.
Guarding and preservation supply continuity from utterance to evidence.
Testifying from knowledge supplies the evidentiary endpoint.

structural_cues: The guarded utterance at 50:18 precedes the soul's arrival with a witness at 50:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies monitored speech and testimony; I connect them to 50:26 only through جعل's naming branch. The materially live alternative is a wholly enacted status assignment with no spoken declaration.

changed_reading.before: The naming sense is a focus-only lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The false divine designation can be an uttered and preserved act for which testimony makes the offender answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus act is flanked by obstruction and boundary crossing, then by the companion's denial that he caused transgression. The divine status assignment becomes accountable conduct whose agency cannot simply be displaced onto an associate.

activation_trace.role: Status assignment keeps the accused grammatically active in producing the rival rank.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the offender's obstructive conduct.
Crossing a limit supplies the behavioral form of the rival status assignment.
An associated companion supplies the nearby candidate onto whom agency might be shifted.
Boundary-crossing disobedience is the action whose causation the companion denies.
Deviation from guidance supplies the accused's already-standing condition.

structural_cues: 50:25's conduct profile precedes the relative clause, and 50:27's companion denial follows the completed sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the flanking profile and denial; I infer that the sequence allocates responsibility for the focus assignment back to the accused. Alternatively, 50:27 may deny only general causation of transgression, not specifically the act in 50:26.

changed_reading.before: The verse punishes possession of a false theological commitment.
changed_reading.after: It charges an agentive boundary-crossing designation embedded in obstructive conduct and resistant to blame-shifting onto a companion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عذاب here directly denotes punishment, not water. It remains valid only as a secondary root-branch resonance anchored in عذاب and activated by the packet's water-provision-life circuit; downstream prose should describe exclusion from life-giving sweetness as an added image, never translate عذاب as thirst.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: العذاب الشديد, especially root ع ذ ب

activation_trace.role: Sweet palatable water supplies the positive pole from which punishment can exclude.
Withholding and weaning supply the exploratory deprivation mechanism.
Severity intensifies the proposed deprivation without replacing punishment.
Actual water supplies the context's life-bearing substance.
Nourishing provision supplies what the water becomes for creatures.
Rain-given life to earth supplies the provision circuit's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Severe punishment is undifferentiated inflicted pain.
changed_reading.after: Alongside pain, it can faintly resonate as severe exclusion from potable sweetness, sustenance, and revivifying provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ألقى السمع is an attentional idiom, not a punishment scene. It remains anchored by the exact repeated casting root and by hearing-as-understanding, but downstream prose should present only a rhetorical agency reversal, not claim literal equivalence or direct causality between the usages.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فألقياه, set against ألقى السمع at 50:37

activation_trace.role: Coercive throwing supplies the imposed trajectory of the condemned.
Casting hearing supplies a voluntary redirection of one's receptive faculty.
Understanding and compliance make the voluntary casting responsive rather than merely acoustic.
Present observation supplies the attentive stance accompanying the voluntary act.

changed_reading.before: The casting command is only forced transport into punishment.
changed_reading.after: It can echo an inverse agency pattern: one voluntarily directs hearing toward reminder, whereas the condemned is forcibly directed into punishment.

strongest_changes: The verse becomes a counter-placement: assigning an other divine rank is answered by the assigner's forced punitive placement.
Repeated dual casting and the receiver-driver-witness sequence turn the command into the closing handoff of an evidentiary custody process.
Monitored utterance and testimony strengthen جعل as an accountable act of naming or designation.
summary.what_was_special: Exact casting-and-location recurrences activated settled emplacement and a later reversal between coerced casting and voluntary casting of hearing; the عذب branches also yielded a carefully contained deprivation resonance.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not identify the two commanded agents, so continuity across the paired roles remains inferred.
The naming reading does not require that the status assignment was spoken.
The water-deprivation and attentional reversals are secondary resonances, not replacements for the direct punishment and throwing senses.
